name: Vitest
description: Adds vitest.config.mjs for WordPress JavaScript tests: tests run in Node, *.jsdom.test.* files in jsdom with React Testing Library, and coverage writes tests/logs/lcov.info.

inputs.description: Directory containing the JavaScript source, searched for tests and measured for coverage (relative to project root, no trailing slash, no glob characters such as { } , * ? [ ]). Default 'src'.
Directory for tests that live outside the source, and for the jsdom setup file (relative to project root, no trailing slash, no glob characters such as { } , * ? [ ]). Default 'tests/js'.
source_dir as a JavaScript string literal. Derived from source_dir.
tests_dir as a JavaScript string literal. Derived from tests_dir.
